tei:div.tei:p: 135)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs mchog ster bzhugs: na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ye:

dad dang mos gus ldan pa yi: rigs can skyes bu gang su dag: rim gnyis grub 'bras mngon 'gyur phyir: sgo gsum mi phyed dad pa yis: sku gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma la: gsol 'debs dbang byin bskul ba ni: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi 'di skad brjod: e ma ho: ka dag spros pa bral ba'i pho brang nas: chos sku'i ston pa kun bzang yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: gzhon nu bum skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs: nges pa lnga ldan lhun grub gzhal yas nas: longs sku'i ston pa rigs lnga yab yum la: gsol ba= mtha' bral longs spyod rdzogs skur= mi mjed 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing khams nas: sprul sku'i ston pa rigs gsum 'gro ba'i mgon: gsol ba= gang 'dul sprul ba'i sku ru= rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas nas: brgyud gsum chu bo gcig 'dres pad+ma 'byung: gsol ba= dgongs brgyud byin rlabs 'pho bar byin gyis= 136) gnas yul dur khrod mkha' spyod yongs kyi gtso: ḍā ki'i rje me ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba= sgyu lus 'od skur grol bar= gdan gsum rnam dag sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes lnga rdzogs thod phreng sde lnga la: gsol ba= bde stong phyag rgya chen por= dbyings dang ye shes mnyam sbyor klong yangs nas: sgyu 'phrul ḍā ki 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gsol ba= sku gsum ye shes 'char bar= phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub gzhal yas nas: sgo skyong sde bzhi bka' srung dam can la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: tshe sgrub mthar phyin yang dag don ldan cing: 'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i dpal thob nas: don gnyis lhun grub sku gnyis thob par shog: de ltar mos gus drag po yis: gsol 'debs 'di la brtson gyur na: byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya:
